paragraphs: Rav Yitzḥak bar Redifa said: R. Ammi said, Ketubbot (106a), Shekalim, chapter 4, halakhah 3. He said, ‘Rav Huna said,’ Shabbat (23b). He asked R. Yoshiyah (Shevuot 9:5 as printed; compare Sheviit 9:4). He asked R. Yirmeyah.
